triage.note: The counterpart PR #21 R1/R2/R3 established: a check that asserts the real file is clean also passes vacuously once it regresses, so a known-bad fixture has to prove the miss is actually caught. Six mutations, seven failures, exact count — the checkbox carries two independent defects (`checked` and `disabled`) on one element — `min_failures` alone is a floor and would let a regressed check that ALSO over-fires report green (PR #21 round-2 R5). The shapes are listed in the fixture's own header comment; the two that matter most are the checked-and-disabled checkbox (a paid tier as the deployed default, on a control nobody can untick) and a `routingStrip` that is declared, is never called from the banner, and prints no cost — the demo's own failure shape, a number computed and not shown, moved one layer up.
